integrity.claims: Exact irrational/rational angular phase-retrieval cutoff, constructive finite-degree Vandermonde lift and dimension-sharp linear lifted sample count.
integrity.proof_basis: Local Taylor coefficient comparison, rational angular resonance, nonzero Vandermonde determinant, real dimension of Hermitian matrices.

scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic only; no stability or controlled noise amplification is proved.
The sample count is sharp for unconstrained Hermitian linear lifting, not for nonlinear rank-one recovery.
The holomorphic uniqueness result concerns an interior accumulation point and is not a theorem about boundary sampling.
